title: Forena — Member self-service portal
description: Served as tech lead and lead frontend developer for Forena’s new member portal. Led the architecture and delivery across Next.js, Payload CMS, a .NET API, and Azure. Members can manage their accounts and cases through BankID sign-in, and Forena can update pages without developer help. The portal was built for reuse by other unions on the MMS membership platform.

title: Political party — Membership application
description: Built the React application from scratch and owned its architecture, payments, testing, and deployment. Applicants can join and pay in one flow, and completed applications are sent automatically to the membership system.

title: AutoPlan — Leasing portal upgrade
description: Led the frontend upgrade of AutoPlan’s leasing portal. Built the new Power Pages interface from UX designs, refactored the existing code, and mentored junior developers so they could work more independently in the codebase.

title: Pappers — Union dues reporting
description: Rebuilt the frontend of a legacy ASP.NET app accountants use to report union dues. Adapted the new React interface to a separate .NET 8 API, making the frontend easier to maintain and test.

title: Kommunal — KomMed Web modernization
description: Co-led the rebuild of Kommunal’s membership administration interface in Next.js. Worked with the client’s test lead and moved more logic to the server for better security.

title: TYA — Training and certification
description: Led frontend development for two apps that replaced TYA’s training and certification system. Instructors register training digitally, and drivers sign in with BankID to view certificates and pay for replacement cards. Set up deployment pipelines and Azure hosting.

title: Kommunal — Member motions
description: Built a Next.js app for member proposals and motions. Integrated Dynamics 365 data and improved form validation and the overview for members.

title: IF Metall — Finance applications
description: Built two apps for invoice and ledger workflows with the finance team. Integrated them with Dynamics 365 and helped establish deployment routines.

title: Kommunal — Course administration
description: Built booking and scheduling features for the course administration module in Kommunal’s existing platform, integrated with Dynamics 365.

title: IF Metall — Meetings and case management
description: Worked with a senior developer on a web app for meetings, minutes, and case management, integrated with Dynamics 365.

title: Portfolio
description: This site is a developer portfolio inspired by old .nfo files. Its pages use TanStack Router.
